A1.justification: Both complete 20-page PDFs describe CaPO and include supplementary Appendices A–C. Text and visual inspection support reliable comparison of the main text, equations, tables, figures and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original diffusion-model experiments, benchmark evaluations and ablations in Tables 1–6, plus a human preference study in Appendix C and Table 7.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments, benchmark evaluations, ablations and human preference study, including the appendix results.

M1.justification: Sections 4.2–4.4 retain the same reward calibration, regression objective, frontier-based pair selection and sigmoid loss weighting. No algorithmic or architectural component changes.

E1.justification: Both retain DiffusionDB and Pick-a-pic training prompts and the same Parti, DPG-bench, GenEval and T2I-Compbench evaluations. Appendix C also retains the GenAI-bench prompts used for human evaluation.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches throughout: DPO/IPO and SUM/SOUP/FRS comparisons, FLUX-dev/FLUX-schnell/SD3.5-L benchmark comparisons, Diffusion-DPO/DPO-Syn comparisons, and the baselines in the appendix user study.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix B retain the same sampling settings, training budgets, hyperparameter sweeps, model selection and evaluation procedures. Appendix C retains 200-prompt user comparisons with five raters per pair.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 and Appendix C retain the same synthetic-data comparison, single-versus-multiple reward analysis and loss-weighting ablations. The qualitative examples and reward-distribution analysis are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both report point estimates without error bars, confidence intervals or significance tests. v3 adds no repeated-run or seed information.

E6.justification: Tables 1–7 and the qualitative outputs match. For example, Table 3 retains GenEval scores of 0.59 for CaPO+SDXL and 0.71 for CaPO+SD3-M; Table 7 retains CaPO+SDXL’s 52.0% user-study win rate against Diffusion-DPO.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and derivations in Sections 3–4 and Appendix A are unchanged, including the preference objectives, Jensen inequality bound and loss-weighting relationships.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about calibrated preference optimization, multi-reward alignment, mitigation of over-optimization and improvements without human-annotated preference training data.

C2.justification: Both retain the reward-correlation explanations, limitations on text-rendering improvements and offline convergence, and Appendix B’s qualification that comparisons with larger benchmark models are not fully fair.

D1.justification: Appendix B’s software, hardware, hyperparameters, data-generation settings and model-merging instructions are unchanged. The project-page access information is also retained.

R1.justification: The same 72 references and related-work positioning are retained. Changed citation back-reference page numbers reflect reflow rather than added or removed works.

P1.justification: v3 adds corresponding-author markers and a footnote on page 1 and updates the arXiv version/date header. Scientific prose, terminology and section order otherwise match.

P2.justification: Small spacing and typesetting changes alter column and page breaks; for example, the conclusion’s final line moves from page 8 to page 9. Figures 1–10 and Tables 1–7 retain their designs, labels and content.

improvement.justification: The scientific argument, empirical evidence, derivations, reproducibility information and limitations remain unchanged, including the appendices. Added corresponding-author identification and minor layout shifts do not materially improve or diminish overall paper quality.
